annotations.title: Get Bing inbound links to one URL

description: GetUrlLinks: the inbound links (anchor text + source URL) pointing at one specific page on a project's matched Bing site, read straight from the Bing Webmaster API. FREE (no credits). Own-site only — Bing exposes no competitor/any-domain backlink lookup, and some verified sites are known to return an empty result here even when populated. Bring-your-own-key: requires BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_site' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

url.description: The specific page to find inbound links for.

name: get_bing_url_links
